purpose: Test transfer of the unchanged E59/E62 density-to-velocity reconstruction from an ideal periodic snapshot to a non-periodic OuterRim lightcone with known peculiar-velocity truth, while explicitly buffering probes from source boundaries. This isolates lightcone geometry/evolution before adding a survey mask/HOD stage.

tracer.origin: exact E62 tracer density = 165107 halos / (1000 Mpc/h)^3
tracer.rule: Among central galaxies above the retrieval floor in the outer cone/shell, sort by halo_mass descending then galaxy_id ascending and retain exactly round(n_target*geometric_outer_volume).
tracer.retrieval_floor_guard: minimum selected halo_mass must exceed 1.10 times the retrieval floor
tracer.reason: Match E62 tracer sparsity prospectively so E63B isolates periodic-box to lightcone transfer rather than changing tracer density.

reconstruction.reason: Every probe is required to have the full 256 Mpc/h kernel support inside the complete source cone/shell; this stage isolates lightcone transfer, not survey-mask subtraction.

position_unit_guard.policy: Compare |position| with OuterRim comoving distance. Accept either IRSA Mpc convention (ratio~1, then multiply positions by h) or native Mpc/h convention (ratio~h, no conversion); otherwise fail.

primary_truth_gate.observable: line-of-sight peculiar velocity at the 512 buffered lightcone probes

secondary_diagnostics: Cartesian x/y/z truth Pearson and sign agreement
if_pass: Advance to E64 cut-sky/radial-selection/HOD truth transfer. Observed eBOSS remains sealed.
if_fail: Do not introduce survey masks or observed tags; diagnose lightcone transfer without changing frozen E63B tracer density, kernel or truth thresholds.
